title: About DAVIET
content:
DAV Institute of Engineering & Technology (DAVIET), Jalandhar, was established in 2001 under the DAV College Managing Committee (DAVCMC), New Delhi. It is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and affiliated with I.K. Gujral Punjab Technical University, Jalandhar. DAVIET is the first degree-level engineering institute established by the Dayanand Anglo Vedic College Managing Committee, New Delhi.

The campus is located in Kabir Nagar, Jalandhar, on an approximately 18-acre site adjacent to DAV College, with a canal at the rear and Burlton Park at the front.

DAVIET emphasizes outcome-based education, technical skills, human values, and environmental consciousness. The institute reports collaborations/MOUs with institutions including the University of Ontario Institute of Technology (Canada) and IIT Ropar. Centers of excellence mentioned on the official site include Microsoft Certified Campus, Texas Instruments Innovation Lab, IBM Academy, Huawei Academy, and CISCO Networking Academy.

Address: DAVIET – Kabir Nagar, Jalandhar - 144008, Punjab, India.

title: Mission, Vision and Objectives
content:
Vision (as published by DAVIET): To attain the coveted status of a growth-oriented resource of national importance known for quality professional education, research and innovation.

Mission (as published by DAVIET): To provide professional education with a difference confirming a confluence of inter/multi-disciplinary knowledge domains; targeting excellence in collaboration with industry; promoting creative competence and innovation aimed at producing skilled human resource and entrepreneurs; sustaining Indian ethics and moral values.

Selected objectives published by DAVIET include: providing an academically ambient environment; generating industry-oriented competent manpower; providing R&D facilities; linking industry and institute for sponsored research and consultancy; upgrading faculty skills; pursuing national and international accreditations; developing centres of excellence; and fusing learning with ethics and Vedic preachings.
